subject.title: fix(repair): close staged proof review gaps

question: Should the durable router, authenticated bounded requeue, staged-proof ledger, validation isolation, and final-mutation hardening land together at the current head?
rationale: Source and regression coverage support the implementation, but automation cannot decide whether the combined privileged-boundary blast radius and intentionally terminal fail-closed recovery policy are operationally acceptable.

options.title: Review and land together
options.body: Complete current-head checks and have an independent repair owner verify the coupled privileged-boundary invariants before merging the full stack.

options.title: Split operational policies
options.body: Separate durable routing, validation isolation, or bounded requeue policy into narrower PRs if maintainers want independently reviewable rollout and rollback boundaries.

options.title: Wait for live exercise
options.body: Leave the PR draft until a controlled workflow run demonstrates queue draining, indeterminate requeue handling, and proof publication on the exact head.

recommendation.title: Review and land together
recommendation.body: Complete current-head checks and have an independent repair owner verify the coupled privileged-boundary invariants before merging the full stack.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository policy makes Peter the best available owner for accepting the combined live-workflow operational boundary.
